notes.title: Holiday Update - (24.12.19)
notes.content:
[b]Hi there,[/b]

[b]In honor of the New Year's sale, a winter update will be released.[/b]

[list]

* And so, the whole map was shrouded in snow. The river at the military camp froze. Spirits on the eve of the holiday put on New Year's hats. And Lora is all the same naked and sexy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/4f3dac4d0fa2123c327a44b7269381a780023e61.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/19aba487277647133929bf2b31af6781c2524801.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/4de1af969105f3c69c0af27309fb62a64ecf33fd.png[/img]

* Walking along the road to the east, you can find a path that will lead to a tent of a naked snow maiden.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/de614f2b2e283a51ad2652330c9dbd07a221a481.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/07918d0ec8616dd5b9e9b24d7a31f6cda6db6d4f.png[/img]

* At the request of the players, three dance animations were added. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/b53b0798f6af7dd7e741e2179b33a406282c8930.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/b72469f74482bf733fdd9d0e7658024e052c2519.png[/img]

* Due to changes in weather conditions, the lighting has become brighter and the fog is thicker.

* The construction of the light was changed from dynamic to static, which positively affected the optimization of the game.
[/list]

[i]Yo-ho-ho, Lustful holidays to you.[/i]

notes.title: Lustful Update - (18.12.19)
notes.content:
[b]Hi there,[/b]


[b]In this update, the main female characters were completely redone, as well as two sex scenes were added.[/b]

[list]
* The main character Lora is completely changed. Also changed: dress, bandana, panties and top. Sneakers removed. Breast Physics Added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/67562f6669913b0c49388f00fad54bb20c69ceae.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/edb9463530fd0f454b942ea0bf55d4c1b613fb57.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/a0ff837c2a0a52ef1ebd1c8136034a884c3e5b56.png[/img]

* Changed Alexa, a girl from the forest. Naked version added. In the first ending, Alex is replaced by a naked self.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/f667a2cc5921461cdb135c38ef130bf301173c34.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/e06f47e40fba1d11cecb098abd78c27c13a68b17.png[/img]

* Two sex scenes added. 
[list]* The first act takes place with an old character, who was Lora. To do this, clear the military camp. There will be a lifeless body on the bed, with which you can relax a bit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/73690288756590882a8f4220c3caac521a11e9ef.png[/img]

* The second act will be with Alexa. To activate it, you need to complete the second mission. After the conversation, you will find yourself in a truck on which you can also relax.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969725/faa76b169c39eea3638d6b695afee8d7c9675bfe.png[/img]
[/list]

* Added a nude version of the ghost. When killing her, she will turn into a half-naked dead girl, in only panties.

* If you die at the hands of spirits, you will be resurrected at the hut, at the place of rape. Weapons and unused first-aid kits will remain with you. But there will be little health. The spirit that raped you will die and you will not meet him again.

* Added 8 new pictures with naked girls. 7 of them are located on a location with a forest.

* Standard cursor changed to new.

* Fixed a bug due to which SteamVR turned on with the game.

* (Within a couple of days, localization for this update will be released.)
[/list]

  [i]Also, within two weeks, an update with new innovations should be released. All the best :)
[/i]
